title: Brentford Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical, urgent care, and local readiness help points in Brentford.
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 right away. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: West Middlesex University Hospital (Twickenham Road, Isleworth TW7 6AF) — 24-hour A&E. Travel from Brentford station: ~1 mile south-west; ~20 min walk south via Boston Manor Road, Half Acre, and London Road/Twickenham Road, or take bus 235, 237, or 267 (~10 mins). Nearest Major Trauma Centre is St George's Hospital (Blackshaw Road, Tooting SW17 0QT) or St Mary's Hospital (Praed Street, Paddington W2 1NY). 2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres: West Middlesex Urgent Treatment Centre (co-located at West Middlesex University Hospital, Twickenham Road TW7 6AF) — open 24 hours daily for cuts, suspected fractures, burns, and other urgent ailments. 3. Local Hazard Notes: Brentford lies at the confluence of the River Thames, River Brent, and Grand Union Canal. Low-lying areas including Brentford High Street, Brentford Lock, and riverside docks are vulnerable to tidal surges and canal overflow during heavy rains. 4. Supplies: Brentford High Street and London Road host community pharmacies and larger food markets for obtaining emergency medical supplies, batteries, and drinking water. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
